title: GeoQuads — Daily
spoiler: Think forest, desert, mountains and latitude.
help: Find the 4 hidden categories. Each has 4 unique items.

groups.name: Part of the Amazon rainforest
groups.fact: About 60% of the Amazon rainforest lies inside Brazil.

groups.name: Part of the Sahara
groups.fact: The Sahara covers about 9 million km², about as large as the United States.

groups.name: Part of the Himalayas
groups.fact: Himalaya means "abode of snow" in Sanskrit.

groups.name: Crossed by the Arctic Circle
groups.fact: Inside the Arctic Circle the Sun stays above the horizon all day at least once a year: the midnight sun.
